LanguageData.LP_Research_PlanarPacts.label: planar contract law
LanguageData.LP_Research_PlanarPacts.description: Study the contract formats, clause traps and true names of patrons of the Nine Hells and the fey courts. Unlocks the pact lectern: pact scrolls (from "whispers of a patron", Nine Hells caravans and Thayan Red Wizards) must be read at the lectern for 4 hours before you can see the terms, review, negotiate and sign.
